explanation: A largely sense-insensitive lexical detector: it fires on the current token when that word form belongs to the vocabulary of vegetated land, farming and environmentalism (forest/Forest, woods, trees, grass, meadow, prairie, savanna, field, park, wilderness; farm/farmer(s), crops, soil, pasture, agriculture, livestock, hens; natural/naturally, environmental, sustainable, climate, green/Green, renewables, ecology, pollution, fracking, CO/carbon), and it fires even when the word is used in a non-ecological sense (natural numbers, a natural leader, environmental variables, a sustainable business model, server farm, field of mathematics, the CO as commanding officer, the actor Forest Whitaker). It stays inactive (below about a quarter of max) on words for water, weather and bare terrain (ocean, tide, lake, storm, snow, mountain, hills), on wild or pet animals (lion, dog, chicken), on urban or built-environment words (street, garage, bank), and on ordinary text with none of these word forms; the abstract nouns 'the nature of X' and 'programming environment' are weak exceptions.
